title: Cellular deployment depends on Cloud & Branch Connector super admin credentials

prose.text: Cellular Edge deployment runs on Cloud & Branch Connector, so it holds a copy of that product's admin credentials.

prose.label: Rotation.
prose.text: {{stale-credentials}} Whether anything other than super admin credentials works is open {{gap:credential-model}}.

prose.label: Related.
prose.text: The Cloud & Branch Connector API key and sign-in are described in [[cloud-connector.api.authentication]].

checks.do: Whether the Cloud & Branch Connector super admin password was changed without updating the Cellular Configuration page, when SIM devices lose connectivity.

cbc-credentials-required.statement: Zscaler needs the organization's Cloud & Branch Connector credentials to deploy the Cellular service across regions.

quotes: Zscaler requires your organization's Cloud & Branch Connector credentials to initiate deployment of Zscaler Cellular Service across regions.

config-fields.statement: The Cellular Configuration page takes the username and password of the Cloud & Branch Connector Admin Portal super admin and the Cloud & Branch Connector API key, copied from the Cloud & Branch Connector API page.

quotes: Branch Connector Username: Enter the username of the super admin for the Cloud & Branch Connector Admin Portal.
Branch Connector Password: Enter the password of the super admin for the Cloud & Branch Connector Admin Portal.
Branch Connector API Key: Enter the API key copied in the previous step.
From the navigation menu, go to Administration > API >Cloud & Branch Connector API.
Copy the API Key and save it for future use.

stale-credentials.statement: If the Cloud & Branch Connector super admin credentials change, they must be updated on the Cellular Configuration page; not doing so can disrupt service and the connectivity of cellular devices using Zscaler SIMs.

quotes: If you change the super admin credentials of the Cloud & Branch Connector Admin Portal, then you must update the credentials on the Configuration page in the Zscaler Admin Console.
Failure to update credentials in the Zscaler Admin Console can lead to service disruption, affecting connectivity of your cellular devices that use Zscaler SIMs.

credential-model.title: Whether the super-admin credential requirement has an alternative
credential-model.detail: Unverified legacy statement: the captured procedure does not establish whether OneAPI replaces the legacy credential procedure or whether a non-super-admin deployment role exists. The article names only the super admin username, password and the Cloud & Branch Connector API key.
credential-model.blocks: advising on rotating or scoping the credentials Cellular deployment uses
